name: GitHub dependency manifest RESOURCE edge migration

statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration. Earlier versions scoped GitHubDependencyGraphManifest cleanup via HAS_MANIFEST (per-repo); the schema now uses RESOURCE from GitHubOrganization as the sub_resource. Backfill the RESOURCE edge for every existing GitHubDependencyGraphManifest reachable from the currently-syncing GitHubOrganization via its repositories. Scoped by $owner_org_id so multi-org refreshes don't redo the full graph each time. Idempotent (MERGE). Remove in v1.0.0.
statements.query: MATCH (o:GitHubOrganization {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID, id: $owner_org_id})<-[:OWNER {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}]-(r:GitHubRepository {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID})-[:HAS_MANIFEST {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}]->(m:GitHubDependencyGraphManifest {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}) MERGE (o)-[rel:RESOURCE {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}]->(m) ON CREATE SET rel.lastupdated = m.lastupdated SET rel.guard0_org_id = $GUARD0_ORG_ID
